BiblicalUsage: Japhlet was a son of Heber of the tribe of Asher, and the father of Pasach and Bimhal and Ashvath. He stands in the genealogy of Asher with his brother Shomer and his sister Shua.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the families of Asher as carefully as the families of Judah, and Japhlet's sons are named because they belong.
